issue.title: Bug:test_hft_config_deletion_stream failed on phase1 validation with Expected Msg/s >0 but got []

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

test_hft_config_deletion_stream runs three HFT phases (create → delete → create). After collection, results are checked in validate_config_state_transitions, which calls validate_counter_output with expected_poll_interval=None. On the enabled path, Msg/s is only parsed when a poll interval is set, so msg_per_sec_matches stays empty, actual_msg_per_sec is [], and has_active_msgs is always false for create phases—even if countersyncd is reporting data.

After that the test has validation of `f"Phase 1 (create): Expected Msg/s > 0, got {validation_results[phase1_key]['actual_msg_per_sec']}" ` and fail as the actual_msg_per_sec=msg_per_sec_matches = [].

expected_poll_interval was set to None on this pr https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/22975

### Steps to Reproduce

run the test

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

test should pass

resolution.title: [hft] Parse Msg/s without rate validation
resolution.description:
## Description of PR
Summary:
Fix HFT config transition validation after #22975 by parsing Msg/s values even when strict poll-interval based rate validation is disabled.

Fixes #24907

## Type of change
- Bug fix
- Test case improvement

## Approach
### What is the motivation for this PR?
#22975 intentionally passes expected_poll_interval=None for config transition validation so the test does not fail on cumulative average Msg/s drift caused by config application latency.

However, validate_enabled_stream_output only parsed Msg/s inside the expected_poll_interval branch. As a result, config create/re-create phases received actual_msg_per_sec=[] and has_active_msgs=False even when countersyncd output contained non-zero Msg/s values.

### How did you do it?
- Always parse Msg/s values from stable countersyncd reports.
- Keep strict Msg/s range validation gated by expected_poll_interval.

### How did you verify/test it?
- python -m py_compile tests/high_frequency_telemetry/utilities.py
- Reviewed the validation flow to confirm create/re-create phases can detect active Msg/s values while strict rate validation remains disabled when expected_poll_interval=None.
